more_info.overview: Ammonium chloride is an inorganic salt of ammonium and chloride. FDA describes manufacture either through salt reactions in solution or by reacting aqueous hydrogen chloride with ammonia, followed by crystallisation. Food functions include dough strengthening, leavening, flavour enhancement and processing assistance. It is chemically different from ammonia solution.
more_info.origin: Manufactured by salt reactions in solution followed by crystallisation, or by reacting aqueous hydrogen chloride with gaseous ammonia. These are chemical-manufacturing routes for an inorganic salt. The FDA definition describes the reactions and recovery of the crystals.
